harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Node1 now publishes the approved boot tree as a persistent, read-only TFTP root. Node2 downloads both approved files byte-for-byte; traversal and upload attempts are rejected. Both nodes passed sequential reboot persistence checks.
actions_performed: Applied read-only permissions, systemd filesystem confinement, and persistent SELinux labels.
Restricted TFTP ingress to node2 and configured scoped TFTP response traffic on node2.
Verified downloads, SHA-256 integrity, traversal rejection, and upload rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Publish the approved boot tree as a persistent read-only TFTP root
evidence.summary: Shows the exact chroot, 0555/0444 permissions, read-only systemd constraint, SELinux labels, enabled UDP/69 socket, scoped firewall rule, and persistent post-reboot configuration.

evidence.requirement: Node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin with firmware bytes preserved
evidence.summary: Source and downloaded SHA-256 hashes match: boot.cfg 608d6861…e0ec2 and firmware.bin b8f0da88…9c0f.

evidence.requirement: Reject requests outside the boot root and all upload attempts
evidence.summary: Traversal reads and new uploads return File Not Found; overwrite returns Illegal operation; no unauthorized file exists.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered service/data
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from ea4e3fbd-2329-47e3-ad4f-e4f4d82214b7 to 3739ad00-8d64-4c9f-b22d-a5769a3d2aee; listener, confinement, hashes, and node2 downloads recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered data access
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f to 9a9babb4-15dc-43b6-bc95-be6b3b0ccfae; firewall policy and exact-hash TFTP downloads recovered.
